brief: The Calendar provides for a general commemoration of John the Baptist on 24 June, and on 29 August for a particular commemoration of his death at the hands of Herod Antipas. John’s call to repentance and his message of God’s coming judgement had connotations of messianic claims that Herod found extremely worrying. John was eventually the victim of Herodias’s anger at his criticism of her marriage to Herod.
